en: This is an old German postcard from the Deutsche Reichspost era, featuring handwritten address details. The postcard has two green postage stamps in the upper right corner, both with visible postmarks. There are also two prominent round postmarks and a purple oval stamp with the text 'STRASSBURG.' The address is written in German cursive script and is addressed to 'Herrn Carl Jauslin, Kunstmaler, Muttenz, Basel land.'
